## Purpose
Renders one trace as a span tree, with each span's details (attributes, logs, request body, errors), rule verdicts and a link to open it in Mistral.

## Responsibilities
- `buildTree` and `flatten`.
- `TraceView`, `RuleVerdicts`, `SpanDetail` (`Block`, `Pre`) and `OpenInMistral`.
